_comment_overview: LAN Dynamic Wallpaper - Central Host Configuration File

Server._comment_bind: IP address to bind the HTTP server to (0.0.0.0 binds to all available network adapters)
Server._comment_port: TCP port for client HTTP connections and wallpaper image streaming
Server._comment_disc_port: UDP port used for LAN broadcast discovery beacon responses
Server._comment_enable_disc: Enable automatic discovery beacon so clients locate this server without manual IP typing
Server._comment_max_conn: Maximum concurrent client connections allowed by the HTTP listener
Server._comment_timeout: HTTP request timeout threshold in seconds

Security._comment_secrets: AuthSecret and AdminSecret are auto-generated cryptographically (256-bit) on first launch if left empty
Security._comment_auth_req: Require authentication token on private client endpoints
Security._comment_auto_enroll: Automatically enroll clients connecting from private LAN subnets (192.168.*, 10.*, 172.16-31.*)
Security._comment_max_size: Maximum allowed size per uploaded wallpaper file in bytes (104857600 = 100 MB)
Security._comment_exts: Whitelisted media file extensions allowed in the Wallpapers folder

Slideshow._comment_timer: SLIDESHOW ROTATION INTERVAL: Time in seconds between wallpaper changes (e.g., 5 = 5s, 10 = 10s, 60 = 1 min). Host auto-reloads this setting dynamically without restarting!

Paths._comment_wallpapers: Directory where you drop wallpapers and photos (relative to Host/)
Paths._comment_published: Directory where validated wallpapers are published for client streaming
Paths._comment_logs: Directory where daily rotating server log files are stored
Paths._comment_store: JSON store recording registered client nodes, MACs, and online statuses
